translationRepairs: On guimao in the fourth month, Venus trespassed on Net (Bi).
On guiwei in the fourth month, Venus trespassed on Net (Bi).
Chinese 癸未 is the day guiwei, not guimao (癸卯); the idiomatic English misreads the sexagenary day.
Prince Yan of Fuling and his son Nan Fang also plotted treason; though guilty of a capital offense, Yan was spared death and reduced to marquis.
Prince Yan of Fuling and his son Fang also plotted treason; though guilty of a capital offense, Yan was spared death and reduced to marquis.
Chinese 子男魴 means “his son Fang” (男 marking a male child); English “Nan Fang” wrongly treats 男 as part of the personal name.
Further Prince Yan of Fuling and his son Nan Fang plotted rebellion, a capital crime without principle; he was spared execution and demoted to marquis.
Further Prince Yan of Fuling and his son Fang plotted rebellion, a capital crime without principle; he was spared execution and demoted to marquis.
Same error as idiomatic: 子男魴 is son Fang, not Nan Fang.
